name: 57104 · Sioux Falls, SD
findings: ZIP 57104 (Sioux Falls) has 216 nonprofit organizations. 108 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 88 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 57104 (Sioux Falls) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 57104 (Sioux Falls) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.5 times the typical level).
